text:
Alex: Morning — planning a miniwave deploy today 18:00 PDT. Two parts: API proxy change and model-encoder v3. Need owners and quick rollback plan. Who can take what?

Maria: I can take the API proxy 18:00 slot. I'll run the smoke checklist and post results here.

Chris: I’ll own model-encoder v3 canary. Plan: canary at 18:05 (10% traffic eu-west, 10% us-west). Will watch for 30m. @Maria please confirm proxy is live before I start canary.

Jamal: Quick q — do we need a canary in ap-southeast as well, or just eu/us for this miniwave?

Alex: For this miniwave let's stick to eu/us only — lower blast radius. If the canary looks good we can expand next wave.

Chris: Canary routing snippet: ```routes:
- region: eu-west
  weight: 0.1
- region: us-west
  weight: 0.1```

Maria: Smoke checklist I’ll follow and post result in ~10m after proxy deploy:
1) /health and /encode return 200
2) p95 latency < 300ms
3) no error spike in logs or Sentry
I’ll post `smoke: pass` or `smoke: fail`. :white_check_mark: :x:

ops-bot: deploy job queued by Chris -> job_id=9921. Estimated start 2026-03-17T18:00:12Z.

Chris: Starting canary deploy now (job 9921). Hitting with canary-set-1 load (100rps).

Maria: smoke: pass. /health green, /encode p95 240ms, no error increase in last 5m. Archive at s3://redwood-telemetry/smoke/1769874321/. :white_check_mark:

Alex: Solid. Jamal, are you rollback owner if we see regression?

Jamal: I'm standby. Rollback plan: immediate rollback to model-encoder:v2 and scale down canary. Command: `redwood rollback --model model-encoder:v2 --strategy immediate`. Will confirm when executed.

Alex: Timings: full cutover target 18:30 if no regressions. If major issue before 18:25 we roll back. Everyone OK with that window?

Chris: OK from me — will post final status after 30m watch.

Maria: I’ll monitor metrics and logs during watch window and ping if anything looks off.

Alex: Thanks team — I'll update the release-train doc with owners and windows. :thumbsup:
